propositions: The step-budget exhaustion diagnostic (repetition counters: tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) is computed by failure_usage but discarded before reaching the operator message because raise_completion_workflow_failure is never called on the budget-exhaustion path.

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist filter strips the four repetition keys and rejects the list-valued top_repeated_tool_calls, preventing the diagnostic from surviving the recovery-exception merge and the primary-exception merge.

Operators cannot distinguish a looping failure (high repetition) from a true budget exhaustion (low distinct calls) without reading logs, because the gate_error_v1 sidecar is never written and the close-gate message carries no repetition summary.

The fix widens _bounded_diagnostic to allowlist the four repetition keys, relaxes the scalar-only merge guard for top_repeated_tool_calls, and renders the aggregate_-prefixed projection through format_repetition into the operator message.
